name: Kugama Naka
source:
"Hmm, hmm. Kuga is on your side." 

A kouhai to Kazuya and Ritsu. She has known them since before they starting attending Tatemori Gakuen.

With her lovely appearance and approachable personality, she is well-liked by those around her.
She is a calm, collected, and intelligent girl.

[Translated from [url=https://nenaico.com/samaao/chara07.html]official website[/url]]
